textbookBox.concept: India has over 1.4 billion people, about 18 percent of the world's population, so great diversity is not surprising. A survey counted 325 languages in 25 scripts.

beats.en: India has over 1.4 billion people, about 18 percent of the world's population, so great diversity is not surprising. A survey counted 325 languages in 25 scripts.
beats.speakEn: India has over 1.4 billion people, about 18 percent of the world's population, so great diversity is not surprising. A survey counted 325 languages in 25 scripts.

beats.en: People in different regions eat different foods. Staple grains such as rice, wheat, millets and maize are the basic food for most Indians. Spices, vegetables and oils vary, and one vegetable can be cooked in many ways.
